For purposes of study and evaluation, the corridor locations are presented as naths 500-feet in width extending from an interchange location in the vicinity of I-94 easterly to the airmort entrance road located east of Howell Avenue. Each is not intended to define a specific width of a corridor or right of way but is provided to show the general aspects and impacts of the various locations considered. Existing land uses were summarized in figure 15. The locations of these alternatives are as shown in figure 16.
A brief locational description for each corridor is as follows:
Corridor #1 As a multi-lane highway proposal connects to existing I-94 (North-South Freeway) with an interchange at Grange Avenue and proceeds easterly over an updated Grange Avenue for approximately 1.3 miles and then northerly using existing Howell Avenue to the airport entrance road. The approximate distance traveled along this route is 1.66 miles.
Corridor #2 - connects to existing I-94 ('lorth-South Freeway) with an interchange connection located south of Edgerton Avenue, or approximately midway between Layton Avenue and Grange Avenue, and proceeds southeasterly crossing the C.M. St. P. & P. Railroad approximately 1,700 feet north of Grange Avenue. From this point the corridor extends easterly and parallel to Grange Avenue to the airport entrance road. The approximate length of this route is 1.39 miles.
